profile.description: American AI-powered video editing and generation software company

bullets: Own a Direction, Not a Backlog: Set the strategy for your surface, commit to the metrics it should move, and be the one accountable when they don't move.
Own the AI Quality Loop: Define what "good output" means for a generative feature, build the evaluation that measures it, and use that eval to decide what ships and what doesn't.…
Be the Taste and Quality Bar: Act as the filter for what "good" looks like on a product used by millions. Every feature should feel considered, polished, and worth the user's…
Ship at Scale and Breadth: Run multiple feature workstreams in parallel without losing depth or craft. Know when to go deep on one feature and when to parallelize across several.
Codify a Repeatable Playbook: Turn your instincts into a method for how to scope, validate, and ship AI-powered features fast, and use it to raise the bar for the broader PM team…
Conduct user research and analyze feedback and product data to identify user needs and product opportunities.
Experiment with LLMs and other AI models to understand their capabilities, limitations, and potential product applications.
Design and conduct evaluations for AI-powered features, including test cases, success criteria, and analysis of model outputs.
Translate user insights and experimental findings into product hypotheses and requirements.
Own or support features through development, launch, and iteration, working closely with engineering and design.
